::: {#fig-scatter-chol-sbp}

```{r}
wcgs |>
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::aes(x = sbp, y = chol) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Systolic BP (mmHg)", y = "Cholesterol (mg/dL)")
```

Cholesterol versus systolic blood pressure in the WCGS dataset,
with a least-squares line
